context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 儀礼/貫く/浮き彫り/造船/応じる/騙し/辞退/モニタリング

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地域研究、儀礼の歴史、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Sakura, your project on local ritual history is really fascinating.
lines.style: Warm professional interest. Lean forward slightly. Steady eye contact. Opening lands gently on her name—recognition before evaluation. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。地元の伝統を貫く保存会、取材しました。
lines.en: Yes. I interviewed the preservation society that maintains the local traditions.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the work. Straightforward delivery—no self-doubt. Slight lift at the end, inviting follow-up. Sitting a little taller.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高齢化の課題、浮き彫りになりましたね。
lines.en: The aging problem really came into sharp focus through their stories.
lines.style: Knowing nod in the voice. Thoughtful pace. Slight sadness underneath the observation—she sees what Sakura uncovered. Not lecturing, reflecting alongside her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 造船関係の元職人さんの話、貴重でした。
lines.en: The shipbuilder—the former craftsman—what he shared was invaluable.
lines.style: Soft emphasis on 'invaluable.' Voice catches slightly with genuine respect for what he carries. Pause before his role, centering him. Almost tender.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 要望に応じるインタビュー、難しい場面もありました。
lines.en: Getting people to participate was difficult sometimes, wasn't it? Some interviews didn't go as planned.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of the human difficulty. Lower register. Searching her face slightly—checking that she's okay. Not prying, but present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昔の騙し被害、口を閉ざす方も。
lines.en: Some people who'd been hurt in the past wouldn't talk about it.
lines.style: Quiet realization in her voice. Matter-of-fact but weighted with compassion. Pause before 'wouldn't talk'—respect for their silence. Slow exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 参加を辞退する方、モニタリング、慎重にね。
lines.en: Anyone who decided not to participate—you'll need to handle that sensitivity carefully.
lines.style: Shift to gentler guidance. Lower, more direct. Not an instruction but a shared responsibility. Pause between clauses. Voice lands on 'carefully' with quiet insistence.
